content: <amvlasov> Will it be affected by BALs? I think it’ll be easier to witness rlp(BAL) for all initial witness and so on, and plain-hash it, instead of encoding it back. So essentially block witness will only need bytecode hashes/tree hashes preimages (including leaf values), previous block and some CL related data
